title: The Apothecary Diaries Movie Reveals Key Visual, Trailer, December 11 Premiere
content: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Consort’s Hidden Treasure movie revealed a key visual, trailer, and December 11 premiere date. The movie is set to release in the middle of Season 3, which will air over two parts in Fall 2026 and Spring 2027. Crunchyroll recently confirmed that it will stream the sequel TV anime .

title: The Legend of Aang’s Rumored Release Date Continues an Unfortunate Trend for Avatar: The Last Airbender
content: The Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender has faced a rocky road ahead of its release, and it now looks like it could debut on an earlier date than expected. It’s a turn that would continue an unfortunate trend for the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise. It’s a shame, as its continued popularity demands so much better.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Studio Shares New Look at Original Anime
content: Studio Madhouse has long been one of the biggest anime studios in the world, responsible for anime classics old and new alike. In its history, Madhouse has been responsible for the likes of Trigun, Hunter x Hunter, Death Note, One-Punch Man , and Overlord, with these examples only being the tip of the iceberg.

title: 'Eleceed' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, First Promo
content: The official website for the Eleceed television anime revealed the main cast, additional staff, and the first promotional video on Thursday. The anime adapting Jae-Ho Son and ZHENA 's super power action webtoon is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
